title: fix(release): pass VERSION env to build-pkg so dist-pkg dir matches tag
body:
`build-pkg.sh` reads the version from `package.json` unless a `VERSION` env var is set. When releasing v0.1.1, the output lands in `dist-pkg/rancher-secrets-manager-0.1.0/` (package.json version), but the copy step looks for `rancher-secrets-manager-0.1.1/` and fails.

Fix: set `VERSION: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}` on the build step.
